source: DepEd Order No. 009, s. 2026 — three-term school calendar (issued 2026-04-20). Dates cross-checked: gmanetwork.com explainer 984622, depedclub.com, teachpinas.com.

curriculum_quarter_inference.rule: MATATAG competencies are organised in FOUR quarters; SY 2026-27 runs THREE terms. No official quarter-to-term pacing guide was found. Infer: fraction = instructional weekdays elapsed / total instructional weekdays (end-of-term blocks count as the end of that term's instruction); quarter = min(4, floor(4*fraction)+1). Outside the school year (summer) there is no current quarter: every quarter weights x1.
curriculum_quarter_inference.replace_when: DepEd publishes a MATATAG curriculum map / pacing guide for the three-term calendar.
